description: Games per day and where they are played: starts vs finishes, wins and losses, the difficulty mix, device and shell, and how a deploy rolls out. Schema: docs/agents/metrics.md.

panels.title: This range
panels.description: Abandonment needs no column of its own: it is started − finished, which is why the game sends no abandon event. A restart counts as a new play, and every count is a floor — sampling, content blockers, the Privacy switch, and the packaged macOS/iPhone apps all subtract.

targets.query:
SELECT
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0))  AS started,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))    AS finished,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0))    AS won,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'lost', _sample_interval, 0))   AS lost,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))   AS win_rate,
  (sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) - sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))) / sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) AS abandon_rate,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', double1 * _sample_interval, 0.0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS mean_seconds
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')

panels.title: Games per bucket — started vs finished
panels.description: The headline. The gap between the two lines is abandonment: boards opened that never reached a win or a loss. Bucket size is the Bucket variable; buckets are UTC, as the dataset is.

targets.query:
SELECT
  intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), $bucket) * $bucket * 1000 AS t,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) AS started,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))   AS finished
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Wins and losses per bucket
panels.description: Finished games only, stacked — the height is games finished.

targets.query:
SELECT
  intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), $bucket) * $bucket * 1000 AS t,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0))  AS won,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'lost', _sample_interval, 0)) AS lost
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Win rate per bucket
panels.description: Wins ÷ finished, per bucket. Buckets with no finished game are dropped by the HAVING clause rather than drawn as a zero.

targets.query:
SELECT
  intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), $bucket) * $bucket * 1000 AS t,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS win_rate
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY t
HAVING sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Boards opened, by difficulty
panels.description: The share of boards opened at each tier — what people choose, before it turns out how it went. Unlike the board and device panels, this runs on the whole range: difficulty is one of the original columns, so a game from before 0.2.83 counts here too.

targets.query:
SELECT
  blob2 AS difficulty,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) AS plays
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY difficulty
HAVING sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY plays DESC

panels.title: Boards opened per bucket, by difficulty
panels.description: Whether the mix is shifting. Stacked, so the height is every board opened in the bucket and each band is one tier.

targets.query:
SELECT
  intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), $bucket) * $bucket * 1000 AS t,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start' AND blob2 = 'easy', _sample_interval, 0)) AS easy,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start' AND blob2 = 'medium', _sample_interval, 0)) AS medium,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start' AND blob2 = 'hard', _sample_interval, 0)) AS hard
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Difficulty — plays, finishes and win rate
panels.description: How each tier goes, over the whole range. 'Abandoned' is plays minus finished. Three tiers should give three clearly different win rates — board size and mine count are measured by scripts/difficulty/, and this is where that measurement meets what people actually do.

targets.query:
SELECT
  blob2 AS difficulty,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) AS plays,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))   AS finished,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'start', _sample_interval, 0)) - sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS abandoned,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0))   AS won,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'lost', _sample_interval, 0))  AS lost,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS win_rate,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', double1 * _sample_interval, 0.0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS mean_seconds
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY difficulty
HAVING sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY plays DESC

panels.title: Schema coverage
panels.description: blob4..blob12 arrived in 0.2.83; every event older than that deploy is still here with those columns empty. The three panels below, and all of Boards & engagement, count only the left-hand number — so they will not add up to the trend panels above, which read columns that have always been written. This is the size of that gap, and it closes on its own.

targets.query:
SELECT
  sum(if(blob4 != '', _sample_interval, 0)) AS with_columns,
  sum(if(blob4 = '', _sample_interval, 0))  AS before_0_2_83
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')

properties.value: Carries the board and device columns

panels.title: Games by device
panels.description: Device class is decided from pointer coarseness and the screen's shorter edge, never by parsing a user agent — so a touchscreen laptop lands on 'tablet'. Blank means an older build that predates the column.

targets.query:
SELECT blob10 AS device, sum(_sample_interval) AS games
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND blob4 != ''
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY games DESC

panels.title: Games by shell
panels.description: standalone = installed to the home screen and launched from there; browser = a normal tab. The packaged macOS and iPhone apps report nothing at all, so they are in neither slice.

targets.query:
SELECT blob11 AS shell, sum(_sample_interval) AS games
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND blob4 != ''
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY shell
ORDER BY games DESC

panels.title: Device × shell — and how it goes there
panels.description: Finished games only. Win rate is wins ÷ finished for that pair.

targets.query:
SELECT
  blob10 AS device,
  blob11 AS shell,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0))  AS won,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'lost', _sample_interval, 0)) AS lost,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS win_rate,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))  AS games
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND blob4 != ''
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')

panels.title: Games per bucket, by build
panels.description: How a deploy rolls out — old builds linger in service-worker caches. Events with no version at all are excluded here; they are the pre-0.2.83 population and would otherwise be drawn as one nameless band.

targets.query:
SELECT
  intDiv(toUInt32(timestamp), $bucket) * $bucket * 1000 AS t,
  blob12 AS version,
  sum(_sample_interval) AS games
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND blob12 != ''
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY t, version
ORDER BY t

panels.title: Version over version
panels.description: The panel for the deploy that changed something: did the mean game get shorter, did the win rate move?

targets.query:
SELECT
  blob12 AS version,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0))  AS games,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end' AND blob3 = 'won', _sample_interval, 0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS win_rate,
  sum(if(blob1 = 'end', double1 * _sample_interval, 0.0)) / sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) AS mean_seconds
FROM hypersweeper_game_events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND blob1 = 'end'
  AND blob12 != ''
  AND ('$difficulty' = 'all' OR blob2  = '$difficulty')
  AND ('$surface'    = 'all' OR blob6  = '$surface')
  AND ('$family'     = 'all' OR blob7  = '$family')
  AND ('$device'     = 'all' OR blob10 = '$device')
  AND ('$shell'      = 'all' OR blob11 = '$shell')
GROUP BY version
HAVING sum(if(blob1 = 'end', _sample_interval, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY version DESC
